name: Kosmos Airways
blurb: A premium Russian carrier flying long-haul from Moscow Sheremetyevo and St Petersburg, with further hubs at Domodedovo, Nizhny Novgorod and Novosibirsk.

about: Kosmos is a premium Russian carrier, flying from Moscow Sheremetyevo and St Petersburg with further hubs at Moscow Domodedovo, Nizhny Novgorod and Novosibirsk. It competes at the top end of long-haul flying, against the leading Gulf and Asian carriers.

The airline was founded in Moscow in 1991, emerging from what remained of Aeroflot after its break-up. Its first fleet combined Tupolev Tu-134s and Tu-154s, Antonov An-24s and Ilyushin Il-62s with Airbus A310-300s and Boeing 737-400s leased from Aeroflot.
When Transaero went bankrupt in 2015, Kosmos and Aeroflot divided its remaining assets. Kosmos took the Airbus A380s, Boeing 747-8Is and Airbus A350s that Transaero had ordered but never received.
network: Sheremetyevo is the main hub, with long-haul services to Beijing, Lagos, Dubai, Paris and Dallas and domestic flights as far as Khabarovsk. St Petersburg links Russia with Shanghai, Manila, Minsk, Victoria Falls and Denver.
Domodedovo is Moscow's backup hub. It handles the A380 and 747-8I, which Sheremetyevo cannot accommodate, and takes every Moscow flight if Sheremetyevo closes.
